title: Privacy Gateway
description: Routing, classifier, upstream and egress health of privacy-gateway. Content-free metrics only.

panels.title: Public share (auto)
panels.description: Share of model=auto requests sent to the public provider over the selected range.

panels.title: Egress blocked
panels.description: Outbound calls refused by the egress guard. Must stay 0 — anything else is a bug.

panels.title: Clef error ratio
panels.description: Share of Clef calls that failed (timeout, transport, HTTP, invalid answer). Empty when there were no calls.

panels.title: Top routing reasons (range)
panels.description: Why requests were routed local. Codes: detector:*, clef_choice:*, clef_category:*, clef_error:*, unsupported:*, session_*, document_attached:* …

panels.title: p(public) distribution (range)
panels.description: Bucketed p(verdict=public). Threshold policy.thresholds.public_min_prob (default 0.80): below it → local.

panels.title: Max category probability (range)
panels.description: Highest has_<category> probability per call. Threshold category_max_prob (default 0.30): above it → local.

panels.title: Clef input tokens
panels.description: Large states approach clef.max_state_chars → too_large_for_classifier (routed local).

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: hit = request routed local by a sticky session; pinned = session flagged sensitive.
